diagnostic.message: The elastic issue stage added one cycle to every fixed-latency INT dependency, and the stable-slot dispatch ring rejected rename while full even when a same-cycle pop released capacity.

files_modified.lines_changed: IQ-only scheduler wakeup merge, cross-slot early-wakeup contract, and dispatch ring rename capacity
result-ready early wakeup valid and PRD outputs

evidence: IPC fell from 1.214660 and 60,732,969 commits to 0.939248 and 46,962,398 commits.
Branch hit rate stayed at 97.55% and DCache hit rate stayed near 98.4%, excluding frontend prediction and cache hit behavior as primary causes.
Dispatch block cycles rose from 52,518 to 8,485,308 and average dispatch width fell from 1.23275 to 0.954724.
ROB-head INT wait rose from 12,189,335 to 20,859,368 cycles; ROB-full and free-list-empty pressure also rose by two orders of magnitude.
fixes: Execute announces scheduler-only PRD wakeup only when wb_valid_d and wb_prf_we_d prove the result will enter wb_q on the current edge.
Variable-latency load and DIV/REM producers announce only when their real response/completion is present; stores, exceptions, and no-PRD results are excluded.
BusyTable, ROB, PRF write, and Execute result bypass continue to use architectural exec_complete signals only.
Dispatch ring rename capacity subtracts same-cycle pop_count, allowing full+pop+push without payload compaction.
Early wakeup is localized to the three IQs and removed from DispatchUnit and dispatch-buffer payload updates to limit fanout.
A VERILATOR_TB assertion requires every early wakeup to produce the same PRD on the following-cycle completion slot.
A proposed FreeList commit-free same-cycle allocation bypass was fully reverted because its 0.66% potential IPC benefit did not justify a new Commit-to-Rename timing path.
